EmailTemplate.subject: We have received your compliance documents
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
[{!Account.WCF_Organizational_Name__c}] We have your compliance documents. Here is what we received..
{!Account.WCF_Organizational_Name__c} A few items need updating before your application can move ahead.
We have received your documents
Application {!IndividualApplication.Name} - {!IndividualApplication.Organization_Name__c}
Hi {!Account.Name},
Thank you. We have received the following compliance documents:
{!WCF_Compliance_Document__c.File_Name__c}
Our team will review them. We will write to you again once that review is done. Nothing further is needed from you right now.
View Your Documents
Kind Regards, Wadhwani Grants,
Wadhwani Grants, the grant-making arm of the Wadhwani Foundation.
Questions? Just reply to this email; it reaches me and the Wadhwani Grants team at grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org.
